verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a workspace audit log covering admin and user actions. The only mention of an audit trail (buzz-gh-4) is a one-line marketing claim about agents having their own audit trail. The admin dashboard is documented as showing moderation reports and product feedback, which is a related feature, not an admin/user action audit log.
